chapter: Kid Rene, Chris Kelly and the bungalow
title: First recording and singing in the band
summary: He never recorded in those days and did not sing; band members might sing along.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Did you ever make any records back in those times?

Well no I never did. That's the first record I made I believe with the- Just Playsom? Yeah. The first record I ever made. Well we never had that down there. They never did come in contact with trying to make different bands around like right now. Different band makes records. I was going to ask about the blues with Chris Kelly. Did anybody sing the blues with him? Any member of the band sing? Did Chris sing or anyone else? Oh no. Anybody. I would say anything. Get up there and say anything. Man might just feel good. So I'd say anything you want. Somebody in the band or in the- Somebody in the band. Somebody in the band.
Do that yourself, are you? Ever sing at all? Huh? Do you ever sing yourself in the band?
Me? No. Sometimes I get kind of a little high. I might feel a little happy. But I mean, I was having no songs then.
